ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch on the distal left lobe containing a single dark focal spot; vertically-striated white/black mottling on the distal right lobe; solid black pigmentation throughout the central region surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an acute internal angle; depth is approximately 25% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with varying amplitudes (10-30 pixels) along the entire span of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex curve originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of two small circular high-contrast white spots on the extreme right tip; cluster of raised, irregular white calcified protrusions (barnacles) on the extreme left tip edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark, vertically-oriented linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigmented areas of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and extreme serration along the entire trailing edge boundary; prominent dark circular pigmentation spot on the left lobe white patch.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated dark circular pixel cluster (approx. 20-pixel diameter) located in the mid-field of the white patch on the left lobe.
